audit.whatIsWrong: Rows Level 2 and Level 3 read Camille in both layers while their own explanations say the opposite — whys[1] 'Level 2 stays even — matched Q trades with no clear favourite' and whys[2] 'Level 3 is even'. The packet levelChart also reads Skill for both.
audit.why: Prose, packet and the 52.58% win rate over 1200 games all agree the early levels are neutral; only the two badges disagree.
audit.corrected: Level 2 and Level 3 flipped to Skill as matched full+content pairs. The remaining rows (Skill, Skill, Skill, Camille, Camille) already match the packet and are untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike gives no cooldown for either ultimate, and calls hers a zone lock without saying what the zone does.
audit.why: The Hextech Ultimatum is 140/115/90s at 475 range and Riot's text says it anchors the target to the area — that is what beats Zaahen, whose only exit is a dash. A 140-second rank-1 cooldown is also the single biggest punish window in the lane.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and mid now state the anchor and the 140s cooldown; wants.foe[2] restated around the anchor.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tactical Sweep is absent from the entire matchup — not one field mentions Camille's W, even though its outer half slows and heals her on a 15/14/13/12/11s cooldown. Also: Precision Protocol's auto-attack reset is never given as a tell, Hookshot's wall requirement is stated only obliquely, and the ultimate is written as 'Hextech Ultimatum' when its name is 'The Hextech Ultimatum' (the packet flags this too).
audit.why: The W heal is precisely why anti-heal is core here, and standing in the outer cone is the mistake that loses the extended trade. Hookshot needing a wall is the actionable half of 'dodge her E' — fight in the open and the engage does not exist.
audit.corrected: Tactical Sweep, its 13s cooldown and the outer-half heal added to breakdown.cooldowns and mid; the wall requirement stated in breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d; the auto-reset tell added to report[5].t; the R renamed in spikes[1].text, mid and wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Hookshot is named as the tracked cooldown roughly fifteen times with no duration.
audit.why: Hookshot is 16/15/14/13/12s — 14s at rank 3 — and it is dead entirely wherever there is no wall.

The kit file tags Camille's R with 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it' and 'untargetable', neither of which appears in Riot's description (it dashes to a champion and anchors them). Per the calibration rule I trusted the description and asserted neither.
audit.corrected: No interruptibility or untargetability claim written anywhere.

edits.before: - Camille Hookshot: matchup-defining — Her engage/stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Camille Hookshot (14s at rank 3): it needs a wall — fight in the open. - Tactical Sweep (13s): the outer half heals her, so bring anti-heal. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Her engage/stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It needs a wall — fight in the open. Only engage once it is down.

edits.before: Track Camille's Hookshot: Her engage/stun. Dodge it. When it is down — Combo + R her.
edits.after: Precision Protocol is an auto-reset — her wind-up is the tell, not the ability cast.

edits.before: Still roughly even. R Hextech Ultimatum locks you in a zone for a full combo, but your R Final Retribution answers hers — hold it to peel her isolation ult rather than to open.
edits.after: Still roughly even. R The Hextech Ultimatum anchors you to her area on a 140s cooldown, so your E cannot leave — hold your R Final Retribution to answer hers, not to open.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay even: her E stun and Q burst are real, but your Q and E trade back and you punish every whiffed Hookshot. At 6 her R isolates you, though your R answers it, keeping the fight neutral.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay even: her E stun and Q burst are real, but Hookshot needs a wall and Tactical Sweep only heals on the outer half. At 6 The Hextech Ultimatum anchors you — you cannot dash out of it.

edits.before: R Hextech Ultimatum to isolate and kill you 1v1
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum anchoring you for the 1v1

notes: Camille's W was missing from every field in this matchup; it is now in two. The kit file's flags for her R (channel/interruptible, untargetable) contradict Riot's own description and were not used — worth a look if those derived flags feed anything automated.
